converting_recipes: Lead with the phone-ring outcome, not the aesthetics — the buyer's real question is 'will my phone ring', per PRD §3a
Show a same-day/emergency response CTA above the fold if hours/service data supports it
Put a service-area map or postcode list near the top — trade buyers filter on 'do they cover me' before anything else
Use real before/after or job photos over any stock image when available
local_seo_patterns: One H2 per real scraped service, worded as a search query (e.g. 'Emergency Boiler Repair in Coleraine')
One H2 per real scraped service area town — never invent a town not present in facts
NAP in the footer as text, not just an image, with tel: and mailto: links
LocalBusiness JSON-LD subtype matched to the trade (Plumber, Electrician, RoofingContractor, etc.)
facebook_ad_angles: Before/after or job-site photo + 'Free instant homepage redesign, see it in 48h'
Screen-recording of the AI build happening live — the build itself is the hook
Local trust angle: 'Serving [town] since [year]' when years_in_business is a real fact
trust_signals: Real Google rating + review count from Places (never a rounded-up or invented number)
Licenses/certifications only if present in scraped facts or provided by the operator
Years in business only if stated on their existing site or provided directly
forbidden_slop: Generic laptop/office stock photos unrelated to the trade
Invented review counts or testimonials not present in facts
Invented service-area towns not present in facts
hero_video_cinematography: handheld gimbal glide across a freshly completed job site, warm practical lighting, shallow depth of field on tools and materials in the foreground, a work van softly out of focus in the background
faq_seed_questions: How quickly can you get to me?
Do you work weekends or evenings?
